units.text: The Lord is good to those who wait for Him in a day of affliction, and He knows those who revere Him.
And you shall not swear by My name for an unjust cause, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord your God.
You shall not wrong your neighbour, neither shall you rob; and the wages of the hired worker shall in no wise remain with you overnight until morning.
You shall not withhold the wages of the poor and needy, whether of your brethren or of the sojourners within your cities.
On the same day you shall pay his wages; the sun shall not go down upon them, for he is poor and sets his hope upon them; lest he cry against you unto the Lord, and there be sin upon you.
Fathers shall not die for children, and sons shall not die for fathers. Each shall die for his own sin.
You shall not pervert the judgment of the sojourner, or of the orphan, or of the widow; neither shall you take a widow’s garment in pledge.
Come now, you rich people: weep and howl over the miseries coming upon you.
Your riches have rotted, and your garments have become moth-eaten.
Your gold and silver have corroded, and their corrosion will be a testimony against you and will devour your flesh like fire. You have stored up treasure in the last days.
Look, the wages of the laborers who reaped your fields, withheld by you, cry out; and the cries of the harvesters have entered the ears of the Lord Sabaoth.
You lived luxuriously on the earth and indulged yourselves; you fattened your hearts on a day of slaughter.
You condemned; you murdered the righteous one. He does not oppose you.
And you shall not ill-treat a resident foreigner, neither shall you afflict him; for you were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt.
You shall not mistreat any widow or orphan.
But if you afflict them, and they cry aloud to Me, I will surely listen to their voice,
I will be angry with wrath and kill you with the sword. Your wives will become widows and your children orphans.
At the beginning Thou, Lord, didst found the earth, and the heavens are works of Thy hands.
They will perish, but Thou wilt remain; all will grow old like a garment. Like a cloak Thou wilt change them, and they will be changed.
But Thou art the same, and Thy years will not fail.
Do not be led astray, my beloved brothers.
Every good act of giving and every complete gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow from turning.
By His will He gave us birth through the word of truth, so that we might be a kind of firstfruits of His creatures.
In the eighth month of the second year under Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, Berechiah’s son, son of Addo, the prophet, saying:
“The Lord was angry with your fathers with great anger.
You shall say to them: Thus says the Lord Almighty: Return to Me, and I will return to you, says the Lord.

Do not become like your fathers, against whom the former prophets brought charges, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord Almighty: Turn away from your evil ways and your evil practices.’ But they did not listen attentively to Me, says the Lord.
Your fathers—where are they? And the prophets—surely they will not live forever?

Yet receive My words and My ordinances, all that I, in My Spirit, command My servants the prophets, who overtook your fathers.” And they answered and said, “As the Lord Almighty has arrayed Himself to act according to your ways and practices, so He acted toward you.”
Every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land and the fruit of trees, belongs unto the Lord; it is holy unto the Lord.
But if a man indeed redeems his tithe, he shall add a fifth part unto it, and it shall be his.
And every tithe of cattle and sheep, and everything that comes under the staff in the count—the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.
You shall not exchange a good one for a bad one; but if you do indeed exchange it, its substitute also shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
And to the sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as an allotment in return for their ministries, the service they perform in the Tent of Testimony.
And the sons of Israel shall no longer approach the Tent of Testimony, incurring a death-bringing sin.

And the Levite himself shall perform the ministry of the Tent of Testimony, and they shall bear their offences. It is an everlasting ordinance throughout their generations. Among the sons of Israel they shall receive no inheritance.

For the tithes of the sons of Israel that they set apart for the Lord as a portion set apart I have given to the Levites as an allotment. Therefore I have said to them: Among the sons of Israel they shall receive no allotment.
I learned that the Levites’ portions had not been given, and the Levites and singers doing the work had fled, each to his field.
I contended with the commanders and said, “Why has God’s house been abandoned?” I gathered them and stationed them at their posts.
All Jouda brought the tithe of wheat, wine and oil into the stores,

into the charge of Selemia the priest, Saddouk the scribe and Phadaia from the Levites, and beside them Anan son of Zakchour, son of Mathania, for they were considered trustworthy; distribution to their brothers rested upon them.

And it shall be, when you pass over the Jordan into the land which the Lord your God gives you, if you diligently hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all His commandments which I command you this day, that the Lord your God shall set you above all the nations of the earth.
And all these blessings shall come upon you, and find you, if you diligently hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God.
Blessed are you in the city, and blessed are you in the field.
Blessed are the offspring of your womb, and the produce of your land, the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.
Blessed are your storehouses and your reserves.
Blessed are you when you come in, and blessed are you when you go out.
The Lord your God deliver your enemies who rise against you, crushed before your face. By one way shall they come out against you, and by seven ways shall they flee before you.
The Lord send His blessing upon you in your storerooms, and in all that you put your hand unto, upon the land which the Lord your God gives you.
The Lord your God establish you unto Himself a holy people, as He sware unto your fathers, if you hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God, and walk in His ways.
And all the nations of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall fear you.

And the Lord your God shall multiply you in good things, in the offspring of your womb, and in the produce of your land, and in the offspring of your cattle, upon the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give you.

The Lord open unto you His good treasure, heaven, to give rain unto your land in its season, and to bless all the works of your hands. And you shall lend unto many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over you.
And now, please set your hearts on the time before this day, before stone was placed upon stone in the sanctuary of the Lord,
on how things were with you: when you put twenty sata of barley into a bin, there were ten sata of barley; when you went to the wine vat to draw fifty metretai, there were twenty.
I struck you with barrenness, damage from wind and hail—all the works of your hands—and you did not turn to Me, says the Lord.
Please direct your hearts from this day onward; from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month and from the day the sanctuary of the Lord was founded, put it in your hearts:
whether it will yet be recognized on the threshing floor, and whether the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive trees still bear no fruit. From this day I will bless.”
A psalm of Asaph. How good God is to Israel, to those upright in heart!
But my feet were almost shaken; my steps were nearly poured out.
For I envied the lawless, beholding sinners’ peace,
for there is no refusal at their death, and firmness in their scourging.
They are not in human toils, and they will not be scourged with humans.
Therefore arrogance seized them; they wrapped themselves in their injustice and ungodliness.
Their injustice will come out as though from fat; they passed into a disposition of heart.
They devised and spoke in wickedness; they spoke injustice against the height.
They set their mouth toward heaven, and their tongue passed over the earth.
Therefore my people will return here, and full days will be found for them.
And they said, “How did God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”
Behold, these are sinners, and they prosper; for the age they took possession of wealth.
And I said, “Then in vain I made my heart righteous and washed my hands among the innocent;
and I became scourged all day, and my rebuke comes in the mornings.”
If I were saying, “I will recount it thus,” behold, I would have broken faith with the generation of Thy sons.
And I undertook to understand this; it is toil before me,
until I enter God’s sanctuary and understand their last things.
